rules.name: fresh-member introduction
rules.definition: Every qokaiin occurrence contributes exactly one previously unintroduced member by appending it to the current active order. Each occurrence creates a distinct identity; no earlier identity is reused unless written reference establishes it.
rules.status: proposed; actual trace cannot meet all required roster events without assigning values/arguments to unknown groups.

rules.name: current rank-two selection
rules.definition: Every qoteedy occurrence returns the second identity in the current active order after all earlier explicitly parsed mutations. Undefined when active roster has fewer than two members. This is a selector, not a duty assignment.
rules.status: proposed; no rule binds its result to a later written duty.

rules.name: explicit-member removal
rules.definition: Every qokal occurrence removes one explicitly identified current member while retaining its history. No default target or nearest-token argument is supplied.
rules.status: proposed but unapplied: no member argument is derived.

construction_attempt.parse: No executable complete parse. Three lexical hypotheses and three uniform operations were tried against all72 groups. No unknown token was treated as a no-op, boundary, alias, introduction, count, referent, or duty.
dependencies: Need three written introductions before first successful rank-two selection; the shown qokaiin occurrences do not by themselves establish a completed three-member roster before f83r.2:7. Earlier unknown groups remain unparsed and cannot be silently counted.
Need a written identity argument for removal at f83r.6:3 qokal; the immediately later qokaiin is not an argument by R1 and cannot retroactively identify the removed member.
Need a written duty predicate/content and a construction binding a selected current-second result to its recipient. None is derived; chedy remains unassigned.
Need event ordering/reference across lines; no line break is treated as proof of a clause or event boundary.
Repeated qokaiin is provisionally a fresh introduction each time, not a repeated mention. That assumption does not itself identify A/B/C or prove intended entities.
Repeated adjacent qoteedy at f83r.7:9–10 are both retained as selectors; no deduplication.
construction_attempt.required_trace_result: NOT ACHIEVED: no derived A,B,C → remove B → append D → count 3 → select current second C → assign written duty to C. The changing-recipient contrast with original-slot B cannot be evaluated on this parse.
